submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit image1 only. It is the already-designed character animation frame. Images2/3/4 provide identity/direction/style evidence only; do not reinterpret or recompose from them. Follow the precise correction below and preserve everything else. Facing EAST, the NEAR anatomical RIGHT shoulder/arm must hold the FIVE-red-talisman fan; the FAR anatomical LEFT arm must hold the bronze bell. Image5 shows the CORRECT near-right-shoulder to fan-hand structure. Do not just swap prop positions. Remove the current wrong large near sleeve that reaches down to bell. Redraw that visible near RIGHT red shoulder, upperarm, elbow and ivory-lined forearm sleeve bending FORWARD across the FRONT of the torso, continuously connected to the wrist and hand gripping the fan at his chest. The near fan forearm must overlap the torso in front and its shoulder attachment must remain visible. The LEFT bell arm comes from the hidden FAR shoulder behind torso, its upperarm is partly occluded; its narrower forearm reaches down/back to bell at rear silhouette. The bell sleeve must pass BEHIND the near fan upperarm/torso. Exactly two continuous arms, natural grips, five readable cards. Preserve this frame's face/expression, body lean, knees, BOTH east-pointing shoes, costume details, camera distance and existing canvas positions. Only reconstruct shoulders/arms/overlaps needed for handedness. No zoom or other pose change.
